| q5 | Correct | The result goes back as the model's next input so it can decide its next step. |
| q6 | Partial | The name is only part of it. The model chooses using each tool's full description: name, purpose and parameters. |

You improved on your first attempt on q2 and q5. q6 also changed: it now says only "by the name", where the first attempt mentioned descriptions.
